description: Watch Chintu and Mithu turn a grumpy rain cloud into a fun dance party! Perfect for kids to learn about nature and rhythm. #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon
learning: Teaches children about weather, emotions, and rhythm through music.

scenes.text: Arrey! Dekho, ye gussa cloud kya kar raha hai?!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, cute 3D CGI grumpy grey cloud with lightning bolts, Chintu elephant and Mithu parrot looking curious, sunny forest background.

scenes.text: Oh no! He is raining and sad, Splash Splash Splash!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, 3D CGI grumpy cloud crying blue raindrops, Chintu holding an umbrella, bright colors.

scenes.text: Chintu, dance karo! Thumak thumak, step karo!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, 3D CGI Chintu elephant doing a funny dance step, forest floor with grass, joyful expression.

scenes.text: Mithu, hop hop! Twist and jump, keep it up!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, 3D CGI Mithu parrot jumping in the air, wearing a tiny red cap, action lines for movement.

scenes.text: Badal ab hasne laga, dekho magic ho gaya!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, 3D CGI cloud face transforming from grumpy to big happy smile, rainbows appearing in the sky.

scenes.text: Spin, spin, dance! Raindrop rhythm, take a chance!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, Chintu and Mithu spinning under the happy cloud, colorful flowers popping up from the ground.

scenes.text: Yay! Sab log khush hain! Big happy dance!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, Chintu and Mithu hugging, happy cloud confetti showering, bright high-energy celebration.

scenes.text: Ruko! Kya cloud phir se gussa hone wala hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait, Chintu and Mithu looking back at the cloud with wide eyes, mystery atmosphere, seamless loop transition.
